title: 第七章 厌火围城
content_zh:
在神州大陆上，犬戎没有城市的概念，它们依靠它们的利爪抵御外来的威胁，以厚重的皮毛抗御严寒。

    羽人则以神木为基础筑城，可神木的数量又极其有限，这就成了羽人城市极其稀少。

    夏人建城是很复杂的工程，绝不仅仅是定居点那么简单，一座城市，首先要依山傍水，保证生活交通便利。

    还要依托龙脉，才能保证人丁兴旺，能原本的城防受到龙气的滋润，变得更加坚固。周围也不会灾兽频生，使城市免受凶邪的侵害。

    如果城里册封了城隍，则直接用来保护城市，享受香火供奉的城隍，还能化解怨气，滋养龙脉，关键时候还能以金身击杀敌人。

    招摇城，背靠招摇山，东临丽麂水。

    招摇山上物产丰富，除了蕴藏矿产和玉石外，还盛产一种叫祝余的植物，只需要吃一点点，就会让人不饿。所以他成了华族军粮的重要组成部分，华族的军队就是带着祝余制作的军粮，远征西荒，北上冰原，将领土扩展到极致。

    招摇城头上，招摇侯眉头紧锁一脸愁容。

    招摇城下，一只只全身漆黑，像猿猴一样的生物正在缓慢的集结，这是厌火准备攻击的前奏。

    骑着祸斗的厌火不停挥舞手中的长鞭，长鞭落处队发出一声声的惨叫。在一片片喧闹中，一个方队终于基本完成。

    “这次只用了不到一个时辰。”招摇侯忧虑到。

    当厌火出现在招摇城下时，招摇侯第一次发现，厌火居然没有像以前一样，一窝蜂的攻击，而是开始修筑他们得以营地，虽然营地简陋得可怜。

    依靠以往的经验，招摇侯晚上带人突袭，却面对面地遇到厌火巡逻的骑兵。

    要知道在以往的经验中，厌火也就会在集结地周围，象征性地放点哨兵，其实有没有都一个样，对于哨兵来说，就是换个地方睡觉而已。

    哨兵绝对不可能是骑兵。因为在厌火的社会结构中，骑着祸斗的厌火，是比普通厌火高出一筹，你让他巡逻，这些低等级的厌火睡觉，绝对不可能。

    到第二天，就更加惊喜了，他发现厌火居然会列阵，虽然用了差不多一天时间，但是第二天，第三天一直到今天，一天比一天快，一次比一次阵形要完整。
content_en:
On the mainland of China, Quanrong have no concept of cities. They rely on their sharp claws to resist external threats and their thick fur to resist the cold.

    The Yuren built their cities based on sacred trees, but the number of sacred trees was extremely limited, which made Yuren cities extremely rare.

    The construction of a city by the Xia people was a very complex project, and it was by no means as simple as a settlement. A city must first be surrounded by mountains and rivers to ensure convenient living and transportation.

    It is also necessary to rely on the dragon veins to ensure that the population is prosperous and the original city defense can be nourished by the dragon energy and become stronger. There will be no disasters and beasts around, so that the city will be protected from evil spirits.

    If a city god is enshrined in the city, he can directly protect the city and enjoy the incense offered by the city god. He can also resolve grievances, nourish the dragon's veins, and kill enemies with his golden body at critical times.

    Zhaoyao City is backed by Zhaoyao Mountain and faces Liji River to the east.

    Zhaoyao Mountain is rich in products. In addition to minerals and jade, it is also rich in a plant called Zhuyu. You only need to eat a little bit to make people not hungry. Therefore, he became an important part of the Chinese military rations. The Chinese army took the military rations made by Zhu Yu to expedition to the Western Wilderness, went north to the ice fields, and expanded its territory to the extreme.

    On top of Zhaoyao City, Zhaoyao Hou furrowed his brows and looked sad.

    Under the Zhaoyao City, the dark, ape-like creatures were slowly gathering. This was the prelude for Yan Huo to attack.

    Yanhuo, who was riding Fu Dou, kept waving the long whip in his hand, and the team let out screams after the long whip fell. Amidst the commotion, a square team was finally basically completed.

    "This time it only took less than an hour." Zhao Yaohou worried.

    When Yanhuo appeared under Zhaoyao City, Zhaoyao Hou discovered for the first time that Yanhuo did not attack swarms like before, but began to build their own camp, although the camp was pitifully simple.

    Relying on past experience, Zhao Yaohou led a surprise attack at night, but met face to face with the cavalry on patrol.

    You must know that in past experience, Wei Huo would place some sentinels symbolically around the assembly area. In fact, it didn't matter whether they were present or not. For the sentinels, it was just a different place to sleep.

    There is absolutely no way the sentries are cavalry. Because in the social structure of Yanhuo, the Yanhuo riding Fu Dou is a step above the ordinary Yanhuo. If you let him patrol, it is absolutely impossible for these low-level Yanhuo to sleep.

    On the second day, he was even more surprised. He found that Yanhuo could actually form a formation. Although it took almost a day, the second day, the third day and until today, the formation was faster and faster every day, and the formation was more complete every time.
